about: One row per thing an app can do. Derived from the code and schema/bolt-rules.json. Nothing here is verified in real Bolt yet.

rows.name: Pane: card
rows.limit: One card for the selected row. Strings in bind: up to 4096 characters.

rows.name: Pane: markdown
rows.limit: Body up to 16384 characters.

rows.name: Pane: entity_preview
rows.limit: Facts list up to 40 entries, one tile above. Config default for a detail view.

rows.name: Pane: chart
rows.limit: Types line, bar and sparkline only. Title is the label bind as literal text.

rows.name: Pane: table
rows.limit: Up to 40 columns; totals sum, avg, min, max, count; the engine hands it at most {rules:rows.engine_max} rows.

rows.name: Pane: cards
rows.limit: Layout tiles or grid; tile label cut at {rules:tile.label_cut} characters.

rows.name: Pane: detail
rows.limit: Label and value fields of the selected row.

rows.name: Pane: json_tree
rows.limit: Reads a nested object from the row field named in bind.source.

rows.name: Pane: diff
rows.limit: Two texts, line by line.

rows.name: Pane: image_grid
rows.limit: 1 to 8 columns. Inline data images only in the examples.

rows.name: Panes: map, image, color, weather, date, calc
rows.snippet: (use a url action that opens Maps instead)
rows.limit: A personal app cannot show its own data in these panes: Bolt shows "cannot show app data". Use table, detail, cards or chart.

rows.name: Chart types: pie, donut, area, multi-series, heatmap, gauge
rows.limit: Not shipped. Only line, bar and sparkline draw. Do not use any other chart type.

rows.name: Left list: list, table, cards, detail
rows.limit: presentation.widget is one of list, table, cards, detail.

rows.name: Several views in one app
rows.limit: At most {rules:views.max} views including the overview; view ids match {rules:views.name_pattern}.

rows.name: Drill from an overview row to a list
rows.limit: One Enter. A nav arg is one plain token matching {rules:nav_token_pattern}; no slash. A chain action (kind utility with target_chip) only pre-fills the next command and needs a second Enter: do not use it to drill.

rows.name: Back row on a drilled-in view
rows.snippet: (automatic: the engine adds a Back row to every drilled-in view)
rows.limit: A nav row carries no actions.

rows.name: Drill from a row to related rows of another view
rows.limit: The related view lists rows whose match field equals this row id. No cross-join of two endpoints.

rows.name: Row id from another field (id_field, parent_field)
rows.limit: id_field names the row field used as the id (default id); parent_field is on a children entry. A nav arg is one token, so an id with a space does not work.

rows.name: Filter a list by a typed word
rows.limit: The word filters title, subtitle, badge and the first 5 fields. It is the second word typed; there is no filter field in a row.

rows.name: Launcher filters rows as you type
rows.limit: Set app.searchable to true; the launcher does the filtering on the rows shown.

rows.name: Fresh cache and a stale copy when the API fails
rows.limit: ttl seconds a result is fresh; stale_max seconds an old copy may be shown with its age. A failed call is never cached or shown as zero.

rows.name: A detail pane that changes with the selected row
rows.limit: Works when the row `pane` names a declared view whose right_widget has mode selected_row and kind entity_preview, detail, markdown, json_tree, chart, table or card. Ignored for mode list_data, a view with no right_widget, or kind diff, cards or image_grid.

rows.name: Number tiles with a meter, unit, note and badge rules
rows.limit: Unit at most {rules:tile.unit_max} characters; trend keeps {rules:tile.trend_keep} points.

rows.name: Footer buttons (url, composer, utility)
rows.snippet:
actions:
  - { id: copy, kind: composer, target: row, label: Copy, insert: "{{row.copy_text}}" }
rows.limit: Bolt shows at most {rules:actions.footer_max_bolt} footer buttons; the kit and engine keep to {rules:actions.footer_max_kit} (Open and Copy count). Bolt keeps {rules:actions.label_kept_bolt} label characters; the button shows {rules:actions.label_shown}.

rows.name: Run action: one click runs this app with a fixed query
rows.snippet:
actions:
  - { id: refresh, kind: run, label: Refresh, query_template: "overview refresh" }
rows.limit: kind run needs a query_template of fixed text. No example yet.
rows.example_note: no example yet; copy the snippet

rows.name: Footer button icon
rows.snippet:
actions:
  - { id: open, kind: url, label: Open, icon: globe, url_template: "{{row.open_url}}" }
rows.limit: Icon names are lowercase and case-sensitive, from the list in schema/bolt-rules.json (actions.icons); anything else is refused.
rows.example_note: no example yet; copy the snippet

rows.name: Open a place in Maps from a row (instead of a map pane)
rows.limit: A personal app cannot draw the map pane; the row Open button opens the place in a browser.

rows.name: Row actions: Open and Copy from config
rows.limit: Config rows carry Open (url) and Copy (copy) only; more buttons need the app file actions.

rows.name: Icons in config.json and the app file
rows.limit: Icon names are case-sensitive: config.json names come from kit/schema/icons.json; footer-action icons come from actions.icons.

rows.name: Typed input form with validation
rows.limit: Types text, number, date, select, toggle. Bad input shows one "Not saved" row and saves nothing.

rows.name: Secret input field
rows.snippet: (not used by any example; read the key with get_secret instead)
rows.limit: The launcher accepts type secret but the value reaches the script as a plain word and the run log is not measured. Use the keychain or a 0600 .env file.

rows.name: REST list endpoint
rows.limit: GET only; at most {rules:rows.engine_max} rows per list; 10 s per request, 14 s together.

rows.name: A list of ids, then one request per id
rows.limit: limit 1 to {rules:rows.engine_max}; requests run in parallel; ids that fail are dropped.

rows.name: API key sent as a query parameter
rows.limit: The key is stripped from the answer before anything is cached or shown. Prefer a header when the API allows it.

rows.name: API key sent in a header
rows.limit: The key goes only to the host of base_url.

rows.name: No key at all
rows.limit: Leave key_env out.

rows.name: Date tokens in a path: {today}, {today-7d}, {today+1d}
rows.limit: Local dates, 0 to 9999 days; sample mode uses _now from fixtures.json.

rows.name: An object of lists keyed by date or name
rows.limit: flatten is true or the field name that keeps the key; keys sort.

rows.name: A second host for one endpoint
rows.limit: Full addresses must be https on the base_url host or a host in allowed_hosts. The key is never sent to a second host.

rows.name: Refuse an answer that lacks fields
rows.limit: On an object endpoint; an answer without them counts as failed, never as zero.

rows.name: Chain endpoints: one answer feeds the next path
rows.limit: Lookup mode only: {earlier_step.field} and {query}; values are URL-quoted. Views mode cannot call a per-id endpoint.

rows.name: A command line tool
rows.limit: Personal pack only; argument list, no shell; per-OS command table; 60 s at most; stderr is not seen.

rows.name: A service on this computer (http_local)
rows.snippet:
http:
  port: 11434
  request: { method: GET, path: /api/tags }
  parse: json
rows.limit: Loopback only, one GET or POST, no script, no secrets. Bolt reserves ports 13017 to 13027 and 15432 to 15441.

rows.name: A local file the person names
rows.snippet: (path comes from the query word; see insights.py)
rows.limit: Declare files; caps on size; a path cannot travel in a nav arg.

rows.name: An MCP server
rows.snippet: (see the MCP workaround script in ENGINE.md)
rows.limit: No native MCP runtime. A bridge script can call one tool over stdio; tested only against a stand-in server, not a real MCP server.

rows.name: Keys from the keychain or a private file
rows.limit: Lookup order: environment (terminal only), keychain, then a 0600 .env file. A shell variable does not reach the script under Bolt.

rows.name: Keys stripped from API answers before cache
rows.limit: Strips the key (as written, URL-encoded, hex, base64, any letter case), user:password@ and credential-named query values, also inside nested, fragment and encoded links. Cannot strip: HTTP Basic base64 at another alignment, HTML entities, colon-separated hex, a split key, a key held as a JSON number, a value encoded twice. A key under 3 characters is refused.

rows.name: Sample data: no key, no network
rows.limit: Ship live (api.fixture_default false). Put "fixture": true at the top of check.json; an installed pack cannot be switched to sample data.

rows.name: Several sources at once inside one deadline
rows.limit: Partial failure shows per-source rows; an unread value is never zero.

rows.name: permissions block in the app file
rows.limit: Declared and shown at install and compared with what the files use (permissions_differ). Bolt does not enforce it at run time.

rows.name: Sandbox: a script confined to what it declares
rows.limit: Not shipped. A personal script runs as you, with your files and network. Confinement is planned. Install only code you have read.

rows.name: Windows
rows.limit: Unproven: the command table accepts a windows entry and check can run fixtures labelled windows, but nothing has been run on Windows.
